2026-10-16T03:53:52.896Z: auditor fix #2 + re-audit (S6-corridor-net-state/skill): the var-tracking write heuristic treated any > character within 500 chars of a filesystem call as a shell redirect, so JS arrow functions and markdown blockquotes inside solver programs flipped readFileSync/readdirSync calls on the allowed skill directory into a false write-to-skill-dir violation. Fixed: the redirect heuristic now applies only to exec-family calls (execSync/execFileSync/spawnSync/exec/spawn); writes are otherwise detected by exact fs write-function names and by structured write tool calls. Re-audit of the unchanged transcript (verified: the only nested write call targeted the cell agent-output directory; skill-dir accesses were readdirSync/readFileSync reads): verdict invalid:roaming -> ok. Same fixup-and-re-audit precedent as the r1 UNC_RE correction (.step5-unc-fixup.md); judge-side caliber unchanged.
